fields.description: The Grove model these sell prices apply to. One Enabled pricing per model; enabling a new one disables it.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Enable to price from 00:00 UTC today; Scheduled to take over on a later day. Never disabled by hand and never re-enabled: a wrong price is a new pricing plus a credit row for the days before.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Scheduled: the UTC day it takes over, ahead of today. Otherwise stamped on enable; history prices by it and the predecessor prices the days before.
fields.label: Enabled On

fields.description: One row per priced counter. A counter with no row here bills 0 — sell rates come from here alone.
fields.label: Rates
